fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The description of the access policy.

fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Rules
Description
fields.help: Customer specified description of the rule.

fields.label: Excluded Principals
fields.help: The identities that are excluded from the access policy rule, even if they are listed in the 'principals'.

fields.label: Principals
fields.help: The identities for which this rule's effect governs using one or more permissions on Google Cloud resources.

fields.label: Conditions
Expression
fields.help: Textual representation of an expression in Common Expression Language syntax.
The conditions that determine whether this rule applies to a request.

fields.label: Operation
Excluded Permissions
fields.help: Specifies the permissions that this rule excludes from the set of affected permissions given by 'permissions'.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.help: The permissions that are explicitly affected by this rule.
Attributes that are used to determine whether this rule applies to a request.
A list of access policy rules.
